name: yt-dlp
author: Misty
overview: yt-dlp reviews and downloads public HTTPS media through Misty’s restricted native service into a folder you choose.
capabilities: Review single videos or bounded playlists
Convert downloads into MP3, M4A, MP4, or WEBM
Save media into an explicitly chosen folder
permissions: Connect to public media sites through Misty’s filtered network service
Write completed media into a folder chosen explicitly
getting_started: Install yt-dlp and FFmpeg through the Host-managed system toolchain.
Open yt-dlp from Apps in a workspace tab.
Paste a YouTube URL, choose MP3 or MP4, and start the download.
changelog: v0.4.0 - Replaced shell access with explicit destination grants and a Host-owned restricted downloader and filtered public-network service on macOS.
v0.3.0 - Added workspace-tab launch behavior, bridge readiness, and automatic job recovery.
v0.2.0 - Added dependency checks, URL inspection, playlist safeguards, cancellable download jobs, bounded playlists, safe command arguments, and output reveal.
v0.1.0 - Added the initial yt-dlp panel.
